stableIdentity: xas-<sha256(canonicalDigest({domain, type, projectId, attemptId, invocationId, dshSessionId}))>

idempotency.mechanism: the durable payload contains ONLY immutable facts — no ingestion timestamp — so a retry is byte-identical and an idempotent no-op
idempotency.sameIdDifferentContent: fails closed with ExecutionAssociationConflictError; no last-write-wins
idempotency.transaction: BEGIN IMMEDIATE per append; rollback on any error
